title: Google Hotels Autocomplete Scraper
description: Discover Google Hotels destinations and accommodations from multiple queries in one run.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Destination, landmark, area, or hotel-name prefixes. You can also provide a comma-separated string through the API.

q.title: Single Query
q.description: Compatibility alias for one query. Queries and q are combined and deduplicated when both are provided.

gl.title: Country
gl.description: Two-letter Google country code, such as de, us, gb, or fr.

hl.title: Language
hl.description: Two-letter language code, such as en, de, es, or fr.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code used in generated hotel-search links.
